name: @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for Puppeteer browser automation. Enables headless page navigation, screenshot capture, and element clicking.

tools.name: puppeteer_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the automated browser to a specified URL.

tools.name: puppeteer_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the currently loaded browser page.

tools.name: puppeteer_click
tools.description: Click an element on the active web page using CSS selector.

selector.description: CSS selector of element to click
